title: Schematic Render (Ver. 2025.0)
content: ### Objective View 3D Garments with outlines and details shown in a format similar to that of flat fashion sketches or stylized 2D sketches. ### Location Main Menu ▶ Render ▶ Schematic Render 3D Window ▶3D Display Render Options ▶ Schematic Render ### Operation 1. Select the tool/menu indicated in Location above. → Render the 3D garment according to the schematic format. 2. Set the following options as needed. Option | **Description** ---|--- **Line Thickness** | Show or hide the silhouette line (the outline of the area where the garment and the background meet and the line of the wrinkled area inside the garment), Seamline, Internal Line and Topstitch line and adjust the line thickness. **Topstitch** | **(ver 2025.1)** Set specifications of Topstitches to achieve a visual appearance in the Schematic Render. 1. Click the Topstitch in Topstitch tab of the Object Browser. 2. In the Property Editor, activate the **Local Schematic Scale** option by clicking the checkbox. 3. Set the Topstitch parameters that appear below. * **Length** : Adjusts the length of each thread. * **Spacing** : Defines the spacing between each thread. * **Offset** : Adjusts the distance of the stitch from the edge of the applied line. * **Thickness** : Controls the visual thickness of the stitch thread. * **Width** : Sets the width of the stitch(especially Class 500 & 600 stitches). * **Distance** : Defines the distance between each stitch line. **Line Color** | Adjust the Color of the line. **Garment** | **Color** | Adjust the Color of the garment. **Texture** | The applied texture can be viewed as is. **Brightness** | Adjust the Brightness of the garment.
content_description: Explore and customize 3D garments in a schematic format, allowing for detailed visual adjustments and stylized representations similar to flat fashion sketches.

title: ZIPPER: Zipper Tape Properties
content: ### Objective Modify the Zipper tape properties. ### ### Location 3D Toolbar ▶ Select/Move ▶ Zipper Tape (Click On Zipper Tape)▶ Property Editor ### Operation 1. Follow the indicated guideline below: 3D Toolbar ▶ Select/Move ▶ Zipper Tape (Click On Zipper Tape)▶ Property Editor → The properties of the selected Zipper Tape appear in the Property Editor. 2. Modify the Zipper Tape properties based on the available options below: **Properties** | **Description** ---|--- Name | Rename the Zipper Tape. Line Length | Edit the length of the Zipper teeth. Preset (ver. 2025.0) | Set the preset of the Zipper from Custom, Plastic_01, Plastic_02, Metal, Nylon, Reverse_Nylon, Invisible. Texture (ver. 2025.0) | Set the Teeth type to Texture or OBJ. Size (ver.11) | Set the size of the Zipper. Teeth Width | Enter directly the width of the Zipper to adjust. Total Width | Adjust the Tape width of the Zipper. Width | Set the width of the Zipper Tape. The texture image changes based on the width entered. Thickness | Set the Zipper Tape Thickness. Particle Distance | Adjust zipper tape's Particle Distance. Fasten Zipper | Zip or unzip the Zipper. Fold | Adjust the Strength of the fold for Sewing between the Zipper and Pattern. Material | Set the Material Type, Texture, Color and Opacity of the Zipper Teeth and Tape. Physical Property | Adjust physical properties to the selected zipper teeth.
content_description: This webpage provides a comprehensive guide for modifying the properties of Zipper Tape in a 3D design environment, including options for name, size, texture, material, and physical attributes.

title: Fabric Style Window
content: ### Objective Add and organize fabric style and apply it to the garment. ### Location Object Browser ▶ Fabric Style Tab (ver. 2025.0) Main Menu ▶ Window ▶ Object Browser ▶ Fabric Style Tab (ver. 2025.0) ### ![](https://support.marvelousdesigner.com/hc/article_attachments/47438423459353) Operation #### Open Fabric Asset Library 1. Open the Fabric Library tab in Location. 2. Select the Asset Library icon ![Asset Library.svg](https://support.marvelousdesigner.com/hc/article_attachments/47438423651097) to open the default location for Fabric Style assets in the New Library Window. #### Add Fabric Style & Apply 1. Select the tool/menu indicated. 2. Click +Add at the top right. Or add a Fabric file by dragging it to the Fabric tab or on the 3D garment. → A Fabric style is added. Click Copy at the top right. → A Fabric style is duplicated. 3. Drag the style to the 3D/2D pattern and apply it. Or after selecting a pattern first, click the Assign button to the right of the Fabric tab or Fabric style. → The Fabric is applied to the pattern. 4. By clicking the left square icon located on the right of the Fabric name, you can toggle texture mapping type between Unified Map / Texture Repeat. Unified Map: Displays textures based on the pattern layout in the UV map. Texture Repeat: Repeatedly displays the texture across the pattern. 5. Click the Plus icon located on the left of the bin icon, to add prints to your Fabric. Select your print image and open. You can still change the Unified Map / Texture Repeat by clicking the icon from process #4. Adjust the Material Property Editor. #### Group Setting (ver. 2025.0) 1. To set Fabric Groups, Click the Create New Folder button at the top left of the Fabric tab. → A new folder group is created. 2. Click the Add Fabric or Open Fabric Files buttons on the right side of the group to load the Fabric file. → A Fabric style is added or opened to the group. 3. Click the Edit Folder Name button on the left of the group to edit the name. 4. Click and Drag the Fabric to different groups. → Right click on the Fabric, select Drop as Copying, to drop the fabric to the other group folder to copy. This allows to keep the Fabric in the original group folder while making a copied Fabric in the new group folder. → Right click on the Fabric, select Drop as Moving, to drop the fabric to the other group folder.
content_description: This webpage provides a comprehensive guide for adding, organizing, and applying fabric styles to garments using the Fabric Style Tab in Marvelous Designer (ver. 2025.0).

title: Segment Sewing (2D)
content: ### Objective Establish Sewing Lines on segments of Patterns or Internal Shapes/Lines. ### Location Main Menu ▶ Sewing ▶ Segment Sewing 2D Toolbar ▶ Segment Sewing ### Operation 1. Follow the indicated guideline below: Main Menu ▶ Sewing ▶ Segment Sewing 2D Toolbar ▶ Segment Sewing 2. Click once on the Pattern segment to establish the first half of the seam. 3. With the mouse cursor, hover over the segment to be sewn to the first half of the seam. Drag the mouse to make the the Directional Notches parallel to each other. Then, click to establish the second half of the seam. ※ Note * When Directional Notches are crossed, the Sewing Lines in the 3D window are crossed as well. When Patterns are simulated at this state, either one of the Patterns is reversed and then sewn to the other Pattern. * When establishing the second half of the seam, difference in the Sewing Line lengths appears in blue next to the mouse cursor. If the difference exceeds 1 inch, the difference appears in red to alert the user. * Use the shortcut to establish M:N Sewing Lines. For more detail, please reference M:N Segment Sewing.
content_description: This web page provides a step-by-step guide for establishing sewing lines on pattern segments and internal shapes using the Segment Sewing tool in the 2D Toolbar.

title: Remove Device from Marvelous Designer website
content: ### Applicable for: Marvelous Designer 10 and under * From **Marvelous Designer 11** onward, licenses are automatically deactivated when the software is closed. The __Remove Device__ option is no longer required. Problems * Worked with Marvelous Designer on the office computer and tried to log in to Marvelous Designer with a home computer, but it says it is already in use. * Tried to log in to Marvelous Designer on a new computer, but it says another computer is already in use. * Worked on the desktop and tried to log in to the laptop, but it says it is already in use. How to Remove Device 1) Log in to the Marvelous Designer website and go to My account. [https://www.marvelousdesigner.com/mypage ](https://www.marvelousdesigner.com/mypage) 2) Check the Account tab. 3) Scroll down and click the "Remove" button next to the Remove Device. Read more * When the Marvelous Designer software is running, the Remove button does not appear on the Marvelous Designer website. * After the Marvelous Designer software has completely quit, the Remove button is displayed on the Marvelous Designer website. * If you exit by selecting "Log out" or "Deactivation" in the software, the Remove button will not appear on the Marvelous Designer website. * Depending on the region, network, and Marvelous Designer server status, the Remove button may be delayed up to 15 minutes. * Remove Device does not cancel your Marvelous Designer license or subscription.
content_description: This webpage provides guidance on how to remove a device from your Marvelous Designer account for versions 10 and under, addressing common login issues when using multiple computers.

title: How can I fix the 2GB file size limit error when saving?
content: ## **Question** When I try to save my project in Marvelous Designer, a warning popup appears saying **"Files exceeding 2GB cannot be saved as a single ZPRJ file."** and I cannot save my file. How can I fix this problem and save my project? ## **Answer** The problem occurs when the total file size of your project exceeds the maximum limit (2GB) allowed for a single `.zprj` file in Marvelous Designer. This is mainly caused by heavy animation recorded data or high-resolution texture files. To resolve this issue and successfully save your work, please check and try the two methods below: #### **1\. If the recorded animation data exceeds 2GB:** If you have recorded a long animation, the data cached in the track can easily exceed 2GB. In this case, you can manually divide the animation into multiple files by cutting the layers. * **Step 1:** In the **Animation Editor** timeline, right-click on the specific frame time where you want to split the sequence. * **Step 2:** Click **'Cut Layer'** from the context menu to split the animation track. * **Step 3:** Separate and save the divided sequences into different project files (e.g., `z1.zprj`, `z2.zprj`, `z3.zprj`) so that each file stays under the 2GB limit. #### **2\. If multiple heavy texture files are applied to the garment:** If your project contains multiple high-resolution graphics, heavy normal maps, or large background textures, the file size will increase drastically. * **Resize Textures:** Check the original file size of the images applied as textures. Open them in an image editor (like Photoshop) to lower the resolution or compress the file size before re-applying them to Marvelous Designer.
content_description: This webpage provides solutions for users encountering the "Files exceeding 2GB cannot be saved as a single ZPRJ file" warning in Marvelous Designer, offering step-by-step methods to reduce project size and successfully save their work.

title: Avatar Skin Offset Setting
content: ### Objective Avatar Skin Offset refers to the distance between the avatar's body and garments. As the avatars and garments are composed of mesh, the avatar's body may penetrate and show through garments if the avatar's Skin Offset is low (when the distance between avatar's body and garments is close) and the Particle Distance is large. To prevent this, the avatar's default Skin Offset is set to 3mm, which is suitable for garment production. Lower the Skin Offset value for precise fitting measurement or for detailed Simulations when producing form-fitting garments. ※ Note: Lowering the Skin Offset lowers the Particle Distance to prevent penetration of garments and also lowers the Simulation speed. It is preferable to keep the default value when working on the garments and once it is done, lower the value and Particle Distance together for fit checking or to use it as an image. ### Location 3D Toolbar ▶ Select/Move ▶ Select Avatar ▶ Property Editor ▶ Skin Offset ### Operation 1. Follow the indicated guideline below: 3D Toolbar ▶ Select/Move ▶ Select Avatar ▶ Property Editor ▶ Skin Offset 2. Enter desired value between 0~100. 3. Click Simulate to simulate according to the set value.
content_description: This webpage provides guidance on adjusting the Skin Offset for avatars in 3D garment design to ensure proper fit and prevent mesh penetration.

title: 3D File (COLLADA) Import
content: ### Objective COLLADA is a commonly used 3D application format that can be exported from 3D tools such as 3DS Max, Maya, Poser, and DAZ Studio and used as Marvelous Designer Avatar or Scene/Prop. For 3DS Max or Maya, install the “OpenCOLLADA” plugin (<https://github.com/KhronosGroup/OpenCOLLADA/wiki/OpenCOLLADA-Tools>) and use it to export in COLLADA format, instead of using the default COLLADA exporter. COLLADA files contain Geometry and Material, in addition to Rigging, Skinning, and Animation data. Avatar Motion Data can be imported into Marvelous Designer in COLLADA file format, then saved as a *.mtn file, which is Marvelous Designer's proprietary format. ### Location Main Menu ▶ File ▶ Import ▶ OpenCOLLADA ### Operation 1. Follow the indicated guideline below: Main Menu ▶ File ▶ Import ▶ OpenCOLLADA → The Open File window appears. 2. Select the desired file and click OK. → The Import COLLADA window opens. 3. Select the settings as needed and click OK. Object Type | Import as Avatar | Morphs the original object into the object designated as the Morph Target. Enter the Transition Frame count into the Morphing Frame Count. The higher the frame count, the slower the morphing process. ---|---|--- Import as Prop/Scene | The simulated object passes through the Garments due to a lack of collision. Scale | Adjusts the scale of the file being imported when a value is entered Garment Position | Move Garment to Start Position | Moves the Avatar and Garment to the location of the first frame (ver2.5.0). ※ Note: If the COLLADA file path includes # (symbols), the file may not load properly.
content_description: This web page provides a comprehensive guide on importing COLLADA files into Marvelous Designer, detailing the necessary steps, settings, and tips for optimal use of 3D assets from popular design tools.

title: Troubleshooting with HASP Driver Errors
content: ## **The Latest HASP driver download (updated June 2022)** * [Mac version](https://cdn.clo3d.com/HASP/Sentinel_Runtime_94691.tar) * [Linux version](https://cdn.clo3d.com/HASP/aksusbd-8.31.1.tar) * [Windows version ](https://cdn.clo3d.com/HASP/haspdinst_8_31.exe) ## **Sentinel HASP Driver Errors on Windows** ### **Objective** The Sentinel HASP Diver is automatically installed with the software, but it fails occasionally. Please download and install the Sentinel HASP Driver which is suitable for your operating system. ### **Operation** **Installing Sentinel Driver on Windows** 1\. Download the driver from the link below. [Windows HASP Driver Download](https://s3.amazonaws.com/s3.md.web.upload/newmdweb/helpcenter/installer/haspdinst_8_31+\(2\).exe) 2\. Enter "CMD" in 'Windows Start Button + Run (R)' to install the driver. 3\. Drag the downloaded haspdinst.exe file and put it on the CMD window to automatically register the corresponding path as shown underlined below. Enter "-i" behind the automatically entered path and press 'Enter' on keyboard to install. ![0.png](https://support.marvelousdesigner.com/hc/article_attachments/47438481245593) 4\. Access to [http://localhost:1947](http://localhost:1947/_int_/ACC_help_index.html) and check to see if the following screen appears to see if the HASP Driver has been successfully installed. If the following screen appears, then installation is successful. ![1.png](https://support.marvelousdesigner.com/hc/article_attachments/47438509264281) 5\. If the following error occurs, the HASP Driver must be deleted and reinstalled. ![2.jpg](https://support.marvelousdesigner.com/hc/article_attachments/47438526236825) ![3.png](https://support.marvelousdesigner.com/hc/article_attachments/47438526436121) #### **Deleting Sentinel Driver on Windows** 1\. Download the driver from the link below. [HASP Driver Download](https://s3.amazonaws.com/s3.md.web.upload/newmdweb/helpcenter/installer/haspdinst_8_31+\(2\).exe) 2\. Enter "CMD" in 'Windows Start Button + Run (R)' to delete the driver. ![4.png](https://support.marvelousdesigner.com/hc/article_attachments/47438482016025) 3\. Drag the downloaded haspdinst.exe file and put it on the CMD window to automatically register the corresponding path as shown underlined below. Enter "-purge -r" behind the corresponding path and press 'Enter' on keyboard to delete. ![5.png](https://support.marvelousdesigner.com/hc/article_attachments/47438482218649) 4\. After the driver has been successfully deleted, refer to reinstall the driver. ## Sentinel HASP Driver Errors on MAC ### **Objective** The Sentinel HASP Diver is automatically installed with the software, but it fails occasionally. Please download and install the Mac OS Sentinel HASP Driver. ### **Operation** #### Installing Sentinel Driver on Mac * Sentinel Driver for Mac [Download](https://s3.amazonaws.com/s3.md.web.upload/newmdweb/helpcenter/installer/Sentinel_Runtime.tar) 1\. Please remove all the dongle keys inserted into the Mac for installation to be done correctly. 2\. Mount "Sentinel_Runtime.dmg" (ver 21.0 Build 77815) ![9.png](https://support.marvelousdesigner.com/hc/article_attachments/47438527013401) 3\. Double-click the Install Sentinel Runtime Environment icon. 4\. Please allow the 'hasplmd' application to accept incoming network connections (this message may not appear). 5\. Access to [http://localhost:1947](http://localhost:1947/_int_/ACC_help_index.html) 6.If you are unable to connect to the URL, try again after 10 seconds later. If it still does not work, reboot and connect again. If the solutions above do not work, please go back to the first step and check again. ![6.png](https://support.marvelousdesigner.com/hc/article_attachments/47438527230489) *If you click Diagnostics, License Manager Version appears with newly installed version; ver 21.0 Build 77815 (Version information of 21.0 Build 77815 appears as this in Diagnostics). ![7.png](https://support.marvelousdesigner.com/hc/article_attachments/47438482949657) 7\. Insert Dongle key into USB port. 8\. If the Dongle key appears in 'Sentinel Keys', the installation is successfully done. ![8.png](https://support.marvelousdesigner.com/hc/article_attachments/47438527554841) #### Reinstalling Sentinel on Mac 1\. Please remove all the dongle keys from USB port. 2\. Mount "Sentinel_Runtime.dmg" with version of "ver 21.0 Build 77815". ![9.png](https://support.marvelousdesigner.com/hc/article_attachments/47438527013401) 3.Double-click Uninstall Sentinel Runtime Environment. ![10.png](https://support.marvelousdesigner.com/hc/article_attachments/47438483463065) 4\. Click Uninstall. ![11.png](https://support.marvelousdesigner.com/hc/article_attachments/47438483624985) 5.If the un-installation is done normally, the dialog above appears. Please press OK button and then click Quit. 6.Reboot your Mac. 7.Install Sentinel Driver. Please refer to the following method; *If you don't follow the guideline, you may not be able to find Dongle keys inserted into your PC or other PCs. Also the other PCs may not be able to find your Dongle key. #### #### Sentinel Driver Known Bugs * Sentinel LDK Protection System Error : invalid XML scope (36) Normally occurred when operating in Marvelous Designer modelist network dongle 1.4.14.7701 (Enveloped with Sentinel LDK 6.4 version or before 6.4). * Occurs with the following conditions: → Network Dongle key (not a local Dongle key) → Marvelous Designer Modelist Network with 2.1.44 or later version. (Enveloped with Sentinel LDK 7.1) → The Dongle key is inserted into another PC. → The version of Sentinel Driver is 13.20 in your Mac. → Operates normally after reinstalling with Mac Sentinel Driver ver 16.0. * If multiple Sentinel Drivers are mounted, the software is unable to find virtual files. If a driver is already mounted, please demount(or eject) it and mount new driver. * Sentinel Driver starts to operate in a few seconds. On occasion, it does not start. In that case, please reboot your PC. * All the Dongle keys should be removed when uninstalling Sentinel Driver. ![12.png](https://support.marvelousdesigner.com/hc/article_attachments/47438483927577)

title: GoZ for Marvelous Designer
content: GoZ Install Run GoZ from Marvelous Designer Run GoZ from ZBrush * * * ## ## Objective GoZ allows direct Import and Export of objects between Marvelous Designer and ZBrush. ## GoZ Install Download the installer using the links bellow. * [**Latest GoZ installer for Windows**](https://s3.amazonaws.com/s3.md.web.upload/marvelousdesigner/GoZ_for_Marvelous_Designer_Windows_1.0.0.zip) * [**Latest GoZ installer for MacOS**](https://s3.amazonaws.com/s3.md.web.upload/marvelousdesigner/GoZ_for_Marvlous_Designer_macOS_1.0.0.zip) ※ Note: * The above GoZ installer works with Marvelous Designer (ver. 2024.2 and above) and is compatible with ZBrush 2022 and later. * To access archived version of GoZ for Marvelous Designer 2024.1 and below (for Windows), please download the installer from the link below: * [**[Archived] GoZ installer (Windows)**](https://support.marvelousdesigner.com/hc/article_attachments/47657221196313) **Install GoZ for Marvelous Designer from ZBrush** 1. Unzip the downloaded zip folder (md_goz_app_[OperatingSystem]_[VersionNumber]), then install GoZ to ZBrush by moving the contents in \MarvelousDesigner\ folder to the following directory: * * Window default directory path: C:\Users\Public\Pixologic\GoZApps\MarvelousDesigner\ * MacOS default directory path: /Users/Shared/Pixologic/GoZApps/MarvelousDesigner/ * ※ Note: For MacOS, after moving the contents in \MarvelousDesigner\ folder to the directory above, go into MarvelousDesigner folder. Please unzip GoZBrushToMarvelousDesigner and GoZInitMarvelousDesigner. 2. After you unzip the "MarvelousDesigner" folder to GoZApps folder, run ZBrush. 3. Go to ZBrush Main Menu ▶ Preferences ▶ GoZ ▶ path to MarvelousDesigner. 4. In the list displayed, click the version of Marvelous Designer you will be using. 5. If a Security Warning pop-up window appears ▶ click Run. 6. Click 'Install' Button to start GoZ Marvelous Designer installation. ※ Note: * Please Click Replace if file already exist in the GoZApps\MarvelousDesigner folder. * If you have multiple versions of Marvelous Designer installed, please note that the newly revamped GoZ for Marvelous Designer is only available for Marvelous Designer version 2024 and above. * You can verify that the path to the Marvelous Designer executable file is correct by checking in the GoZ_Config.txt file located in the GoZApps\MarvelousDesigner folder. **Reinstall GoZ for Marvelous Designer from ZBrush** 1. Preform Force Reinstall by going to ZBrush Main menu ▶ Preferences ▶ GoZ ▶ Force Reinstall 2. In the list of GoZ enabled application, select Marvelous Designer. 3. Click 'Install' Button to start GoZ Marvelous Designer installation 4. If a Security Warning pop-up window appears, click Run. ※ Note: To ensure GoZ plugin is working properly with Marvelous Designer, please keep the default name for Marvelous Designer application as it is, and do not modify its name. * * * ## Run GoZ from Marvelous Designer After installing GoZ for Marvelous Designer, you can directly export Garments, Avatars, Trims and Scene and Props from Marvelous Designer with the Run GoZ menu. #### **Location** Main Menu ▶ GoZ ▶ Export to ZBrush #### **Operation** 1. Make sure Path to Marvelous Designer is correctly setup with the version of Marvelous Designer in use in ZBrush. 2. Select elements in the scene (Avatar/Garment/Trim/SceneAndProps) to be exported to ZBrush. 3. Go to Main Menu ▶ GoZ and select Export to ZBrush. 4. In the pop-up window, in Object tabs, you can add and remove scene elements to export. 5. Set export setting and click OK button. 6. Go to ZBrush, drag in the 3D window. 7. In Subtool, you can find Patterns + Trim become a single tool, scene and prop become a single tool, and each avatar becomes a tool of its own. 8. PolyGroups are automatically assigned: * * Pattern: split per pattern shapes. * Avatar: split per component. * Trim: split per Trim object. * Scene and Prop: split per Scene and Prop. #### Export to ZBrush Settings Object | Select All Patterns * Select/Deselect all Patterns. * Individual selection is available on the drop-down menu on the right. Select All Avatars * Select/Deselect all Avatars/Objects. * Individual selection is available on the drop-down menu on the right. Select All Trims * Select/Deselect all Trims. * Individual selection is available on the drop-down menu on the right. Select All Scene and Props * Select/Deselect all Scene and Props. * Individual selection is available on the drop-down menu on the right. ---|--- #### Unweld Exports Vertex(points of mesh) of sewn pattern parts as multiple objects. | #### Weld Combines Vertex (points of mesh) of sewn pattern parts together as one point. #### Thin Ensures thickness is not exported to Geometry even if the value is increased beforehand. | #### Thick Exports thickness value to Geometry. Basic | Scale | Adjusts scale of file being exported with a unit of measurements. Scale % | Works on top of the unit of measurement above, scale by specific percentage value. * Reset: Reset all settings to Default. ※ Note: * For Avatar and Scene and Prop, selecting a part of an object will have the corresponding object in the object list to be selected. * Selecting only the body of an avatar will result in the entire avatar being selected in the Export to ZBrush dialog. * * * ## Run GoZ from ZBrush You can directly export object to Marvelous Designer from ZBrush through GoZ. #### **Location** Tool ▶ ![](https://support.marvelousdesigner.com/hc/article_attachments/47438736204697) #### **Operation** 1. Set Import Settings in Marvelous Designer from Main Menu ▶ GoZ ▶ Import Settings 2. Under Tool window, make sure Marvelous Designer is set as the current GoZ enabled application by clicking the "R" button shown in the image above.![](https://support.marvelousdesigner.com/hc/article_attachments/47438736364825) 3. Click GoZ button to export currentSubTool to 'GoZ' enabled application, or use the shortcut Ctrl+G 4. Click All button to export all SubTools to 'GoZ' enabled application, or use the shortcut Ctrl+Shift+G 5. Click Visible button to export visible SubTools to 'GoZ' enabled application. 6. Once the object is exported by GoZ, you can see mesh are imported to Marvelous Designer based on Import Setting #### GoZ Import Settings Basic | Load Type | Open | All existing objects will be removed, leaving the imported file only. ---|---|---|--- Add | Add files and keep the existing objects. Object Type | Avatar | Import file as an Avatar type. \- Objects imported as an Avatar type can be muti-selected. Trim | Import file as Trim type. \- For more information on Trim Type, check out [Trim Properties](https://support.marvelousdesigner.com/hc/en-us/articles/47358187139609) Page Garment | Import an Object as Simulation ready Garment, physical properties can be adjusted from the property editor. Scene and Props | Import file as Scene & Props. \- For more information on Scene & Props, check out [Scene and Props Properties](https://support.marvelousdesigner.com/hc/en-us/articles/47358290160921) Page Scale | Adjusts scale of file being exported with a unit of measurements. Scale % | Works on top of the unit of measurement above, scale by specific percentage value. Axis Conversion | It is possible to specify which of the X, Y, or Z axes should be designated as the Up axis. Translation | Align Bottom to Ground | Position the bottom of the imported object on the ground plane. * Reset: Reset all GoZ settings to Default. ※ Note: * After importing mesh as garment using GoZ, some features in Property Editor (such as Mesh Style and thickness rendering, etc.) remain editable but not effective since the imported item is treated as a mesh rather than a pattern.
content_description: This webpage provides detailed instructions for installing, configuring, and utilizing the GoZ plugin to facilitate seamless import and export of objects between Marvelous Designer and ZBrush.

title: Project File (*.ZPrj) Open/Save
content: ### Objective Compress the various files used for Garment creation into one file, and save it. ※ Note: #### Files included in Project (*.zprj) files * *.avt file, with all Avatar-related data [Avatar, Accessories, Arrangement Bounding Volumes, Arrangement Points, Avatar Size, Poses] * If there are multiple Avatars, they are all saved within the Project file (ver2.3.0). * *.zpac file, containing all Garment-related data (3D Garments, 2D Patterns, Fabrics, subsidiary Materials) * *.anm file, if an Animation has been recorded * Any 3D environment settings (Wind, Light, Ground, Background Image/Color, Scenes/Props) * Simulation options set by the user (ver2.3.0). ### Location #### Open Project File Main Menu ▶ File ▶ Open ▶ Project (Ctrl+O) #### Save/Save Over Main Menu ▶ File ▶ Save Project (Ctrl+S) #### Save As Main Menu ▶ File ▶ Save As ▶ Project (Ctrl+Shift+S) #### New Project (ver. 12.1) Main Menu ▶ File ▶ New Project (Ctrl+N) ### Operation #### Open Project File 1. Follow the indicated guideline below: Main Menu ▶ File ▶ Open ▶ Project (Ctrl+O) → The Open File window opens. 2. Select the desired file and click OK to load the file. ※ Note: Double-click the Project file *.zprj or drag and drop it onto the 3D window to open it. 3. Apply any detailed settings, then click on the OK button Load Type | Open a new project file or Add the file additionally. If you add additional files, you can set the position of the object in the X, Y, and Z Axis. ---|--- Object | Enables the selective import of object types included in the project file. * Garment * Avatar * 3D State * Custom View * Scene and Props * Display Settings #### Save Over Project File 1. Follow the indicated guideline below: Main Menu ▶ File ▶ Save Project (Ctrl+S) → The original Project file is overwritten. #### Save Project File 1. Follow the indicated guideline below: Main Menu ▶ File ▶ Save As ▶ Project (Ctrl+Shift+S) → The Open File window opens. 2. Select a location to save the Garment file. 3. Enter the Project name into the File Name tab and press Save to save the file. → A Project file *.zprj will be created along with its thumbnail image. #### New Project (ver. 12.1) 1. Follow the indicated guideline below: Main Menu ▶ File ▶ New Project (Ctrl+N) → The existing file will be closed and a new “Untitled” project file will be created.
content_description: This webpage provides a comprehensive guide on how to compress and save garment creation files into a single project file, ensuring efficient organization and easy access to all related data.

title: Create .HW File and Register .LCN File
content: Offline authentication with LCN file is only available for PERSONAL PERPETUAL & ENTERPRISE STANDALONE PERPETUAL license holders. (Marvelous Designer version 5~9 only) ### ### Operation 1\. Click on the circled area to fully display the Login window. ![hw1.png](https://support.marvelousdesigner.com/hc/article_attachments/47438786922137) 2\. Check or uncheck the circled areas according to the image below, then click on Create HW File. ※ Note: When creating file, save the file name as your user ID. ![hw2.png](https://support.marvelousdesigner.com/hc/article_attachments/47438743357465) 3.Send the newly created .HW file to [contact us](https://www.marvelousdesigner.com/member/signin?returnpage=contact) for a .LCN file request. 4.Download the .LCN file received from the Marvelous Designer Support Team. 5\. Check or uncheck the circled areas according to the image below, then click on Register LCN File. ![lnc1.png](https://support.marvelousdesigner.com/hc/article_attachments/47438787431193) 6\. Once the .LCN file is registered and below message appears, click OK to go back to the Login window. ![lnc2.png](https://support.marvelousdesigner.com/hc/article_attachments/47438759864857) 7\. Double check on the check-boxes' status and the 'Registered' message with a check icon below the Register LCN File button, then click Log In to run the the program. ![lnc3.png](https://support.marvelousdesigner.com/hc/article_attachments/47438760038169)
content_description: This web page provides a step-by-step guide for PERSONAL PERPETUAL and ENTERPRISE STANDALONE PERPETUAL license holders to perform offline authentication using an LCN file in Marvelous Designer versions 5 to 9.

title: FABRIC PHYSICAL PROPERTIES: Adjust Rendering Thickness
content: ### Objective Set Fabric thickness for a Garment in the 3D Garment window. Rendering thickness from the center of the Garment is set for 0.5mm as the default value, and it is adjustable. This thickness value is only visible and does not Simulate as the thickness value space out between Fabrics. ※ Note: To see the rendering thickness, the 3D Garment Rendering Style must be set on Thick Textured Surface. ### Location #### Fabric Unit Object Browser ▶ Fabric ▶ Fabric Item ▶Property Editor ▶ Thickness #### Pattern Unit (ver2.3.0) Select Pattern in 2D/3D Window ▶ Property Editor ▶ Simulation Properties ▶ Add'l Thickness-Rendering ### Operation #### Fabric Unit 1. Follow the indicated guideline below: Object Browser ▶ Fabric ▶ Fabric Item ▶Property Editor ▶ Thickness 2. Enter desired rendering thickness value. →The thickness is now being adjusted and applied. #### Pattern Unit (ver2.3.0) 1. Follow the indicated guideline below: Select Pattern in 2D/3D Window ▶ Property Editor ▶ Simulation Properties ▶ Add'l Thickness-Rendering 2. Enter desired rendering thickness value. →The thickness is now being adjusted and applied.
content_description: This web page provides a comprehensive guide for setting and adjusting fabric thickness in the 3D Garment window, ensuring optimal rendering and visual representation.

title: [Mode] Animation
content: ### Objective Record garment animation. ### Location Main Menu ▶ Change the mode at the top-right corner ▶ ANIMATION ### Operation 1\. Follow the indicated guideline below: Main Menu ▶ Change the mode at the top-right corner ▶ ANIMATION → Animation window appears.※ Note: 'Complete' increases number of simulation checks to process the avatar and garment more precisely. It is recommended to set the Simulation Quality to 'Complete' to stabilize the animation as motion data increases garment collision when recording it. In addition, it provides more realistic results in fabric motion.
content_description: This web page aims to guide users in recording garment animations while optimizing simulation quality for enhanced realism and stability.

title: FABRIC PHYSICAL PROPERTIES: Adjust Buckling Ratio
content: ### Objective Use this function to reflect the tendency of Fabric trying to preserve its shape, and then being bent when applying certain amount of force. The closer the Buckling Ratio gets to 100 percent (%), the more it becomes easily bendable fabric such as silk and jersey. On the other hand, the closer ration gets to 0 percent (%), the more it becomes less bendable fabric such as denim and wool. ### Location Object Browser ▶ Fabric Property Editor ▶ Physical Property ▶ Preset ▶ Buckling Ratio ![Buclking.png](https://support.marvelousdesigner.com/hc/article_attachments/47438785781529)
content_description: This web page provides an overview of the Buckling Ratio function in the Fabric Property Editor, illustrating how it measures fabric bendability from rigid materials like denim to flexible options like silk.

title: Scene and Props Properties (ver.2024.0)
content: Set the Scene and Props properties. When you select a Scene and Props, its properties appear in the property window. **Scene and Props Properties** Properties | Description ---|--- Information | Model | You can change the type of Scene & Props Specification | Collision (ver. 2024.0) | Enable or disable collision handling. When collision is enabled, objects and clothing will collide. Collision Thickness | The thickness of the collision treatment on the surface of the object. Can be entered from 0 to 100. Material (Selected) | Set the [Material](https://marvelousdesigner-hc.zendesk.com/hc/en-us/articles/47358364198425) of the object. Miscellaneous | Mesh Type | Indicates the type of object mesh. Element Count | Indicates the number of points in the mesh.
content_description: This web page provides an overview of the properties for setting and customizing Scenes and Props, including options for collision handling, material selection, and mesh details.

title: Show/Hide Sewing
content: ### Objective When Sewing Lines are too complicated, hide them for clear view as needed. ### Location 2D/3D Toolbar ▶ Edit Sewing ▶ Right Click Pop-Up Menu (on Sewing Line) ▶ Hide Sewing (Selected)/ Show Sewing (All) ### Operation 1. Follow the indicated guideline below: 2D Toolbar ▶ Edit Sewing ▶ Right Click Pop-Up Menu (on Sewing Line) ▶ Hide Sewing (Selected)/ Show Sewing (All) → The selected Sewing Lines or all Sewing Lines show or disappear from the 2D and the 3D window.

title: [Size Editor] Adjust Avatar Size (ver. 10)
content: ### ### ### Objective Create an avatar with your own measurements. As Avatar Editor is powered by thousands of real body scan data, even measurements not assigned by users automatically adjust to the most realistic body shape. ### Location Main Menu ▶Avatar ▶ Avatar Editor ▶ Avatar Size ### Operation 1. Load an Avatar (.avt). Only the avatars provided in ver. 10 V2 and above can be adjusted. 2. Follow the indicated path below: Main Menu ▶Avatar ▶ Avatar Editor ▶ Avatar Size → Measures appear on the Avatar. The editable measures appear in black, whereas the non-editable measures appear in grey. 3. Refer to below graph and adjust the Avatar as needed. **Option** | **Description** ---|--- **Select Avatar** | Select the Avatar to be edited. This option only appears when two or more Avatars are in the 3D window. **Total Body** | Shape the overall body type with Avatar's height and chest width. In order to get realistic shapes for body parts without assignable measurements, use the Total Body option to create an overall shape and then insert measurements under the Details option. **Height** | Assign Avatar's height. ※Note: * Use the drop-down menu on the right to select the unit of the Height. The default unit follows the program's unit. * Degree of Accuracy based on Height Measure Standard: HPS Height > Inseam > Total Height **Total Height** | Insert the height measured from the ground to the head. ※Note: It is more accurate to assign height with either HPS Height or Inseam option as individual has different head length. The Total Height option is not recommended as it has the lowest accuracy. **HPS Height** | Insert the height measured from the ground to the neck. **Inseam** | Insert the height measured from the ground to the crotch. **Width** | Select and insert desired value as the standard of the overall body width **Details** | Configure Avatar's detailed measurements. Due to a technical reason, a small error may be generated even after inserting a specific measure. The error appears in parentheses next to each measurement and the real measurement can be checked with the measure appears on the Avatar. Edit the Avatar based on the measure appears on the Avatar as the numbers appear in the Avatar Editor only shows the measurements assigned by users. ※Note: * Use the drop-down menu on the right to select the unit of the Height. The default unit follows the program's unit. * Each measurement can be checked with the measure that appears on the Avatar. **Basic** | Use the Basic option when only a small amount of body measurements are available. Unassigned body parts are automatically adjusted based on the real body scan data and the measurements inserted by the user. **Advanced** | Use the Advanced option when available body measurements are abundant. When all measurements under the Advanced options are not available, please use the Basic option to create more realistic body as unassigned measurements are fixed with the default values pre-assigned to each option. **Show All Measurements/** **Show Editable Measurements** | By default, only editable measurements appear in the window. To view all measurements, click the Show All Measurements icon. * Use the Save button to save the adjusted measurements and use the Open button to reload. However, any measurements created with lower versions are not compatible.
content_description: Create a personalized avatar tailored to your unique measurements using our advanced Avatar Editor, which automatically adjusts to ensure realistic body shapes based on thousands of body scan data.

title: MetaHuman DNA Importer
content: ## **Objective** [**MetaHuman**](https://www.metahuman.com/en-US) is a next-generation digital human creation technology introduced by Epic Games, offering ultra-realistic character modeling and rigging that are almost indistinguishable from reality. Based on high-resolution 3D scans of real people, it enables precise expression of facial features, skin textures, hair, and body proportions, and works seamlessly with **Unreal Engine** for use in films, games, virtual fittings, and more. Now, **Marvelous Designer** allows direct import of **MetaHuman DNA data** , enabling garment creation that reflects realistic facial structures and body proportions with exceptional accuracy. ※ Note: DNA is the file format (*.dna) used for MetaHuman data. ## **Location** Main Menu ▶ File ▶ Import/Import(Add) ▶ DNA ## **Operation** 1. Prepare the Body and Head files (*.dna) extracted from the MetaHuman Editor (Unreal Engine). 2. Go to **File** ▶ **Import/Import (Add)** ▶**DNA** to open the **MetaHuman DNA Importer** dialog. 3. Load both the Body and Head DNA files. 4. Set the additional import options 5. A seamless MetaHuman combining the Head and Body will be loaded as an Avatar type. ## **Options** Options | Description ---|--- **File** | **Body** | Load the Body file of the MetaHuman. **Head** | Load the Head file of the MetaHuman. **Basic** | **Unit** | Select the desired unit and enter the scale as a numerical value. **Options** | **Auto Add Arrangement Points** | For humanoid avatars only, arrangement points are automatically generated in the import process. **Auto Create Fitting Suit** | For humanoid avatars only, a Fitting Suit is automatically created in the import process. **Axis Conversion** | Modifying Object's Axis direction. ※ Note: * Enable **Avatar Display** ▶**Show Avatar Joint** to control the pose in your desired form. * Create animations by setting keyframes on the joints. * Applying motion files(*.mtn) is not supported.
content_description: Explore the revolutionary integration of Epic Games' MetaHuman technology with Marvelous Designer for creating ultra-realistic digital avatars and garments that seamlessly blend realism and creativity.
